controls_available: Six labelled X/Y/Z slice-step buttons change the linked-plane focus.
Four labelled orbit/tilt buttons change the mesh camera in the simplified surface; direct mesh dragging and slice scrolling are not active in this mode.
Two opaque-labelled segment selectors, SELECT PAIR, and MERGE SELECTED add a selected missing connection.
RED SEED and GREEN SEED controls, a plane selector, a segment selector, and PLACE ACTIVE SEED prepare a cut.
CUT BETWEEN SEEDS removes the selected false join, and CERTIFY REPAIRED BRANCH submits the transcript.
After a merge or split, repair and certification controls are synchronously disabled until a slice-step inspection is supplied.
grouped_control_modes: slice_controls: X/Y/Z plus-or-minus linked-plane navigation; observation-only

clause_i.reason: Because the specimen and all repair opportunities remain static while the agent is inactive, an observation-free q can defer with no-op for any safe history in C_Delta(D), then use optimal continuation. It need not choose a seed or merge pair at the delayed boundary from I_t alone.

clause_ii.reason: A constant bounded-window policy g(I_t, W_t^0) = no-op is already sufficient for the delayed deferral; no visual window is needed to predict any state evolution. The current screenshot supplies the fixed geometry for the eventual static repair, but it does not create a real-time dependency.

clause_iii.reason: There is no autonomous H_t to H_t^tau task-state transition for any positive Delta. The mechanic mutates focus, camera, selections, seeds, and edges only in input handlers, and the stylesheet has no animation or transition. With no-op, the nodes, edges, and available repair choices remain unchanged, so no action strictly loses value or advantage. A deadline or later completion would not satisfy this clause.

common_visible_process: None. The initial opaque-labelled fibre geometry and erroneous topology persist between inputs; visible changes occur only after slice, orbit, selection, merge, seed, split, or certification events. The certification response is action-triggered and administrative, not an autonomous outcome phase.

pre_run.reason: The mathematical definition already yields No because clauses (i) and (iii) fail, so the pre-run override cannot change the label. This configuration has no autonomous outcome phase to measure.

source_evidence.claim: The assigned difficulty 3 profile is three fibres, eight segments per fibre, two missing joins, one false join, ten slices, and crossing density 0.58.

The simplified surface is implemented with labelled plane steps, orbit buttons, segment selectors, and seed controls; its configured play time is 180 seconds with observation_window_ms 0 and one frame per observation.

When a control condition is supplied, generation uses its difficulty, interaction, and parameters; the assigned profile then constructs fixed seeded points and fixed initial, true, missing, and false edge sets.
The browser receives the static node geometry, initial edges, linked-view contract, and focus; hidden truth is separated into grading data rather than being updated by task time.

render creates one model from the supplied state, initializes edges/focus/camera/selections, installs the Branch Repair UI, performs redraw, and registers the mechanic; no autonomous update loop is installed.
All state mutations are synchronous responses to slice, orbit, select, merge, seed, cut, and certification input handlers; merge and split only set the inspection gate after the agent's edit.
The complete mechanic stylesheet contains layout, colour, cursor, and disabled-control rules but no keyframes, animation, or transition that could change the specimen autonomously.
The grader replays a static initial edge/focus state and changes it only for submitted events; it requires explicit post-edit slice inspection and never advances a task-time state.
Verification only loads the exported result and invokes the Branch Repair grader; it adds no autonomous task process.
The normal solver performs visible observations and edits in sequence, then certifies; its waits are test synchronization around input, not environment evolution.
